notes: Restart from the true baseline: 90.8 kg and 28.5% body fat (11 Sep). Goal 0.55% a week, about 0.5 kg. Ten weeks lands near 85–86 kg and 24–25% if you hold it. Rules. 1) Three gym days: Sat, Mon, Wed. Two is a pass. Never make up a session. 2) Eat the written meals, weigh cooked food, and tick every meal every day, including bad days. Logging stopped after 5 Oct, and that was the first sign. 3) Steps at least 7,000 a day. Sleep 7 hours or more. 4) One planned flex meal a week, Friday dinner only. Not a day, not a weekend. 5) Craving at night: water, coffee, or Coke Zero, then wait 20 minutes. If still hungry, eat the next planned meal early; do not add extra food. 6) Weigh every morning; judge the 7-day average, not the day. 7) Week 5 and week 9 are reset weeks: 2 sets per exercise and the training-day meals on all 7 days. 8) Cut 100 kcal (rest-day dinner rice 100 g to 70 g) only if the 7-day average falls less than 0.25 kg a week for 2 weeks in a row after week 3. 9) If energy is 2 out of 5 or lower, or hunger is 4 out of 5 or higher, on 3 days in one week, take a reset week early instead of skipping sessions.

diet.name: Restart — 1,750 / 1,900 kcal, planned Friday flex meal
diet.notes: Egyptian labels. Food only: training day 1913 kcal, rest day 1753 kcal, protein 185–181 g. Two Nescafé with 80 ml Juhayna skim each sit outside this total (about 95 kcal). Coke Zero is allowed; one Red Bull Zero on training days only. Weeks 3–4 ran 1,660 / 1,497 kcal and ended in low energy, cravings, and a week off. These numbers are about 250 kcal higher on purpose. Do not cut below them. Friday dinner may be replaced by one planned flex meal, up to about 900 kcal, protein first, one plate, no leftovers. It is not a day and not a weekend. Week 5 and week 9: eat the training-day meals on all 7 days.

training.name: 3-day full body (Sat / Mon / Wed)
training.notes: Three evenings: Saturday, Monday, Wednesday. Sun, Tue, Thu, Fri are rest. A week with 2 sessions is a pass. A week with 3 is a good week. Never make up a missed session and never stack two sessions in a day. If Saturday is missed, Monday is the first session. If two sessions are missed in one week, do not change the plan; just do the next scheduled session. Every session is about 18–19 sets and 60 minutes. Stop every set with 1–2 reps in the tank. Hold the load until every set reaches the top of the rep range, then add 2.5–5 kg. Week 1 is a re-entry week after the break: 3 sets on the big lifts at the lighter weights written in the notes. Week 5 is a light week: 2 sets per exercise, same weights. Week 9 is a light week as well. No incline-walk finisher; the step floor of 7,000 replaces it.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.notes: Top set 120 kg until you hit 6–7. Leave 1–2 reps in the tank. Week 1 only: 3 sets at about 105 kg.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.notes: Hold 80 kg until every set is 6–7. Week 1 only: 3 sets at 72.5 kg.

exercises.name: Chest supported row
exercises.notes: 70 kg. Add reps toward 10, then add 2.5–5 kg.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.notes: 65–75 kg. All 3 sets at 10–12 before any jump in weight.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.notes: 70 kg until you hit 9–10 on every set, then +5 kg.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.notes: Hold 130 kg until a set reaches 10 reps. Week 1 only: 112 kg.

exercises.name: Pull up or assisted pull up
exercises.notes: Last logged: 25 kg assist for 10, 8, 7, 6. Keep the assist and add reps.
